# Tide Cluster

Components · Live demo & interactive props: `/tango#/tide-cluster`

The collapsed tide disclosure: overlapping colored glyph discs that expand, with a container-transform, into the full named tide pills.

## Props

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `tides` | `TideClusterTideView[]` | yes | — | The tides to disclose. |
| `stageRef` | `RefObject<HTMLElement \| null>` | no | — | Screen root the pill reveals anchor + clamp against (preferred). |

### `tides`: the `TideClusterTideView` model

| Field | Type | Optional | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `string` | no | Stable id (a tide deck id) for the React key / QA hook. |
| `label` | `string` | no | Display name shown on the pill. |
| `description` | `string` | no | Description revealed through the pill's own InfoCard reveal. |
| `tide` | `Tide` | no | Which of the five tides fixes the icon + color. |

## Usage

```tsx
import { TideCluster } from "src/tango/components/hud/TideCluster";

<TideCluster
  tides={[
    { id: "vision", label: "Singular Storm", description: "Foresight and spells.", tide: "vision" },
    { id: "valor", label: "Iron Bulwark", description: "An unbreaking host.", tide: "valor" },
  ]}
  stageRef={screenRef}
/>
```
